text_3be993b770a9: Find and select a location using DS100
text_79d06d496595: Choose a date from today up to one calendar year from today. Click an existing row to renew it. Entries already valid for longer are not shortened.
text_2a7969e948c7: The date must be between today and one year from today.
text_3f4f73514ded: Validity can only be extended here.
text_d5f105a811d5: Select the location from the DS100 list.
text_849119279347: This entry has changed. Reload the inventory and select the row again.
text_7beba8eb9d3d: This location already exists. Select its row to renew it.
text_0e823f077aa4: Orange: valid for three months or less. Red: expired. Entries without a valid date remain neutral.
text_0d7a3c1f177e: Above the location inventory, select a place with DS100 search and add a Valid until date, at most one year from today. Click an existing row to extend only its validity. Orange marks entries with three months or less remaining; red marks expired entries. CSV import is below the list. When syncing GPS, explicitly chosen start stations are renewed from a usable fix, and end stations after a finished recording with later usable fixes, until one year after their capture date; missing entries are created. Later uploads or replayed syncs do not count as new capture dates. Longer existing validity is preserved. Offline, you can view the saved inventory; adding and renewing requires a server connection. New entries are unique per driver and DS100; duplicates are rejected. Use the inventory search to filter by station or DS100. Header arrows toggle ascending and descending sorting. Dates are displayed as DD.MM.YYYY.
text_77b316b2e62e: Add location knowledge via DS100 and renew for up to one year; orange/red validity indicators and automatic renewal of captured GPS start/end stations.
text_3d3f39a3b3e2: For a new location: in Location knowledge, choose a DS100 search result, enter Valid until and click Add.
text_19f615418c9a: To renew: click a row, choose the new date and click Save renewal. New entry clears the row selection.
text_08aec9fd06e3: Use Search inventory for station names or DS100. Header arrows toggle the sort direction. For CSV files, use the import row below the list.
